definitions.explanation: A Shinto ritual performed by a priest to cleanse people, places, or objects of impurities, evil spirits, or bad luck. Commonly performed at shrines for various occasions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{祓|はら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received a purification ritual at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新車|しんしゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、お{祓|はら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new car, so I had a purification ritual performed on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{厄除|やくよ}け→厄除け：24744_yakuyoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お{祓|はら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧きた。
examples.english: Since it's my unlucky year, I went for an evil-warding purification at the start of the year.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
お{祓|はら}い is one of the most common Shinto rituals in Japan. People seek purification for a wide range of occasions: moving into a new house, buying a new car, starting a business, reaching an unlucky year (⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧), or after a period of misfortune.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{祓|はら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive a purification)
- お{祓|はら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧ (to have a purification performed)
- お{祓|はら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go for a purification)

FORMS:
The お prefix is standard and almost always used. The plain form {祓|はら}い exists but is less common in everyday speech.
